value.title: Florence Nightingale
value.snippet: Florence Nightingale (/ˈnaɪtɪŋɡeɪl/; 12 May 1820 – 13 August 1910) was an English social reformer, statistician and the founder of modern nursing. Nightingale

value.title: Florence Nightingale Medal
value.snippet: Florence Nightingale Medal is an international award presented to those distinguished in nursing and named after British nurse Florence Nightingale.

value.title: Florence Nightingale David
value.snippet: Florence Nightingale David, also known as F. N. David (23 August 1909 – 23 July 1993) was an English statistician. She was head of the Statistics Department

value.title: Florence Nightingale Maternity Hospital
value.snippet: The Florence Nightingale Maternity Hospital is a defunct hospital. This building was once a private maternity hospital located in Hillbrow, Johannesburg

value.title: Eliza Roberts (nurse)
value.snippet: the first group of nurses to accompany Florence Nightingale to Scutari Hospital during the Crimean War. Nightingale regarded her as the best of her nurses
